answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 19563 Country: KW Title: my question is about hot water chicken.The chicken is slaughted with knife by saying bismillah allah hu akbar BUT then the whole chicken is put in to hot water then in feather peeling machine is it HALAL. Question: assalamu alaikum my question is about hot water chicken.The chicken is slaughted with knife by saying bismillah allah hu akbar BUT then the whole chicken is put in to hot water then in feather peeling machine is it HALAL.jazakallah khair Answer ID: 19563 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 190/31/TL=1431) If chicken is put in hot water without taking out impurities inside its stomach to an extent that the impurities are absorbed in the meat, so the chicken turns impure ( najis/napak ). Therefore, the chicken should not be put in hot water without taking out the impurities. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
